messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Lina is located in Nolu Accord Talks. That is the reverse of 'Nolu Accord Talks is located in Lina'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Lina is located in Nolu Accord Talks, according to the venue listing published before the summit. The listing treats the Lina district as a single site inside the Nolu Accord Talks complex.
